en: I have a sore throat.
I have had a cough for two days.
I have had a runny nose since yesterday.
My nose is blocked.
I started having a fever today.
I do not have a fever.
I feel very tired.
I feel a little dizzy.
I have had a headache for three days.
My stomach hurts.
I feel nauseous after eating.
I vomited twice yesterday.
I have diarrhoea.
I have been constipated recently.
My throat hurts when I swallow.
My voice is hoarse when I speak.
I keep sneezing.
My eyes are red and itchy.
I have a rash on my skin.
My back has been hurting for a week.
My knee hurts when I walk.
My ankle is swollen.
I have pain inside my ear.
I am not sleeping well at night.
I have not had much of an appetite recently.

zh: 这些症状是今天早上开始的。
en: These symptoms started this morning.
I have felt like this for two or three days.

zh: 这个问题断断续续有一个月了。
en: This problem has been coming and going for a month.
The pain is a little milder than yesterday.
The pain is worse than yesterday.
My symptoms are about the same as yesterday.
My cough is worse at night.

zh: 疼痛大约是十分里的五分。
en: The pain is about five out of ten.
I have tried resting and drinking more water.
I have taken paracetamol.
I have taken ibuprofen.

zh: 我吃了药房买的润喉糖。
en: I have used throat lozenges from the pharmacy.
These medicines have not helped much.
The pain improved after I took the medicine.
I am not taking any medicines at the moment.
I am allergic to penicillin.

zh: 我没有已知的药物过敏。
en: I have no known allergies to medicines.

zh: 我以前没有出现过这种症状。
en: I have not had these symptoms before.

zh: 我以前也有过类似的问题。
en: I have had a similar problem before.

zh: 我不知道这个药的英文名。
en: I do not know the English name of this medicine.
I have brought the medicines I am taking.
This medicine makes me feel sleepy.
I have not taken any painkillers today.

zh: 我想知道这是什么问题。
en: I would like to know what is causing this problem.

zh: 这个症状一般多久会好？
en: How long does this symptom usually take to improve?
Do I need any tests?
Do I need to see a specialist?
What side effects does this medicine have?

zh: 我应该什么时候回来复诊？
en: When should I come back for a follow-up appointment?

zh: 能把药的名字写下来吗？
en: Could you write down the name of the medicine?
Could you write down the diagnosis?

zh: 我需要一张给学校的病假证明。
en: I need a medical certificate for university.

zh: 我的英语不是很好，请说慢一点。
en: My English is not very good. Please speak more slowly.
Could you explain that again?
How much will this consultation cost?

zh: 我有海外学生健康保险。
en: I have Overseas Student Health Cover.

zh: 你们能和我的保险直接结算吗？
en: Can you bill my insurer directly?

zh: 我想预约一位全科医生。
en: I would like to book an appointment with a GP.

zh: 我想了解怎样拿到检查结果。
en: I would like to know how I will receive my test results.
